outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding lasting less than two months postpartum
cohort: 679 women at Uppsala University Hospital, Sweden
finding: Being a first-time mother, reporting emotional distress during pregnancy, and giving birth by cesarean section were independently associated with exclusive breastfeeding lasting less than two months postpartum.
mod_finding: Giving birth by cesarean section was independently associated with exclusive breastfeeding lasting less than two months postpartum (AOR 2.63, 95% CI 1.34-5.17).
